technical.summary: Mixed momentum setup with short-term bullish technicals (Hull flip, RSI rising, Supertrend) but conflicting intermediate trend structure (below 200-MA, below cloud, weak moving average alignment) and overbought oscillators limit conviction.

fundamental.summary: MU shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 82 days—fundamental backdrop is weak.

sentiment.summary: Mixed signals: congressional sales lack conviction (small amounts, non-senior members, 101+ days old), but broad market fear (AAII 42% bearish, Fear/Greed 46) presents potential contrarian opportunity; insufficient news data to confirm setup.

risk.summary: Extreme macro stress with inverted yield curve, crisis-level VIX (219.5), imminent NFP event, and negative macro score (-7) create severe near-term headwinds despite 82-day earnings buffer.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term momentum technicals (Hull flip, RSI rising, Supertrend bullish, OBV/CMF positive) with price near support (52.33) offer tactical entry in fear-zone contrarian setup.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is in crisis (VIX 219.5, inverted yield curve, NFP imminent), price remains below all major moving averages (200-MA, 200-EMA, 50-SMA), Ichimoku below cloud, overbought oscillators, zero fundamental conviction, and earnings risk in 82 days create overwhelming headwinds that outweigh short-term momentum.

decision.entry_rationale: Short-term momentum technicals (Hull flip, RSI rising, Supertrend) offer tactical appeal at support, but macro crisis environment (VIX 219.5, inverted yield curve, NFP imminent) and zero fundamental conviction create unacceptable risk-reward asymmetry.
decision.primary_risk: Macro headwinds (crisis VIX, inverted curve, NFP event) combined with price below all major moving averages and overbought oscillators create high probability of momentum reversal into support breakdown.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already 34 positions in Information Technology sector; adding MU increases concentration risk without fundamental or macro justification.
